sources: Owner-approved twin-valley story and art plan, 17 November 2026
title: Room Beside the Fire
prose: Yamantaka showed me the open way in. Mirlepa shifted his mat, leaving room for another. The fold and the hearth were work someone had done before I arrived.

choices.label: Sit and notice the air
choices.line: Dust settled below the sleeping shelf. I kept the threshold clear.

choices.label: Ask about the household
choices.line: The visitors change; the place they are offered stays.
